story.originalTitle: Sainz extends contract to drive for Williams with new “multi-year” deal
story.summaryEn: Carlos Sainz has signed a new multi-year contract with Williams, extending his commitment to the team.
detailZh: 小卡洛斯·塞恩斯与威廉姆斯签下了一份新的“多年期”合同，延长了他为这支车队效力的承诺。
这一消息公布的前一天，塞恩斯的队友亚历山大·阿尔本确认他明年将继续留在威廉姆斯。
塞恩斯在去年被法拉利放弃、为刘易斯·汉密尔顿腾出位置后加入了这支车队。上赛季他两次在新车队的分站赛中登上领奖台，但车队在2026年的表现急剧下滑，塞恩斯到目前为止只拿到了六分。
尽管如此，塞恩斯表示他对延长为车队效力的合同感到“非常激动”。他说：“我真心相信这支车队的每一位成员，无论是工厂里还是在赛道上的人员，也相信他们幕后正在进行的投入和辛勤努力。”
“我们具备携手扭转局面的实力，”他补充道。“我依然像第一天一样坚定地致力于帮助威廉姆斯重返它应有的位置，我期待着与车队创造更多回忆。”
威廉姆斯车队领队詹姆斯·沃尔斯表示，保留塞恩斯和阿尔本作为车手，让威廉姆斯拥有了“发车区（发车区）上最强大的车手阵容之一”。
“从他加入的那一刻起，塞恩斯在方向盘后的天赋以及回到工厂时的投入，对这个项目都极其宝贵——他日复一日地与工程师们一起寻找每一个千分之一秒，”沃尔斯说。“他是这支车队的领袖，我很高兴他能看到我们继续重建车队过程中的种种可能。”

—— 阿特拉斯康威廉姆斯F1车队 (@威廉姆斯F1) 2026年8月20日
detailEn: Carlos Sainz Jnr has extended his commitment to Williams by signing a new, “multi-year” contract to drive for the team.
The announcement comes one day after Sainz’s team mate Alexander Albon confirmed he will remain at Williams next year.

Sainz joined the team last year after being dropped by Ferrari to make way for Lewis Hamilton. He finished on the podium for his new team in two grands prix last season but their form has dipped sharply in 2026 and Sainz has scored just six points so far.

Nonetheless Sainz said he is “thrilled” to have extended his deal to drive for the team. “I truly believe in the people that form this team, both at the factory and at the race tracks, and the investments and hard work that are happening in the background,” he said.

“We have what it takes to turn this around together,” he added. “I’m as committed as I was on day one to helping get Williams back to where it belongs, and I look forward to creating more memories with the team.”
Williams team principal James Vowles said retaining Sainz and Albon as drivers gives Williams “one of the strongest line-ups on the grid.”

“From the moment he joined, Carlos’s talent behind the steering wheel and dedication back at the factory have been extremely valuable for this project – working day in, day out with his engineers to find every millisecond,” said Vowles. “He is a leader of this team, and I’m thrilled that he can see what’s possible as we continue to rebuild it.”
Getting together at Grove to celebrate our 2027 lineup 🤝💙 pic.twitter.com/AswM95ZsJd
